quote: If the brakes get wet, apply the brakes while riding at low speed to help them dry.

quote: Service more frequently when riding in unusually wet or dusty areas.

quote: *2 : Service more frequently when riding in unusually wet or dusty areas.

name: Crankcase breather service
value: more frequently when riding in rain, at full throttle, or af
quote: Continued Crankcase Breather Service more frequently when riding in rain, at full throttle, or after the vehicle is washed or overturned. Service if the deposit level can be seen in the transparent section of the drain tube.

quote: Always wash your vehicle thoroughly after riding on coastal, treated, muddy, or dusty roads.

name: salt_wash
quote: Aluminum will corrode from contact with dirt, mud, or road salt. Clean aluminum parts regularly
